title: Hera spacecraft gets 1st up-close look at stadium-sized hole punched in asteroid by NASA DART mission
caption:
New images from the Hera spacecraft show the aftermath of the 2022 DART impact mission. Humanity's first attempt to deflect an asteroid left a stadium-sized crater and changed the rock's orbit forever.
